name: tiered-result-cache
title: Typed result caching through edge, KV and an authoritative loader
description: Request-scoped typed JSON result cache: named Cache API, optional KV, and loaders for R2, D1, Durable Objects, Analytics Engine or other sources. Absolute freshness and stale bounds, versioned tenant keys, promotion and strict bypass.
author: Coop <coop@xavalabs.com>

params.name: cacheNamespace
params.description: Storage namespace used by the named Cache and KV keys.

params.name: maxBytes
params.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes per stored envelope and per cache read.

params.name: maxLifetimeSeconds
params.description: Maximum combined fresh and stale lifetime.

bindings.name: RESULT_CACHE
bindings.note: Optional second tier. Omit kv from createResultCache to use only edge and the authoritative loader.

agent.summary: Shared typed result cache for Workers: named Cache API, optional KV, then an application loader for R2, D1, Durable Objects, Analytics Engine or other JSON sources. Tenant/version keys, absolute expiry, bounded JSON, request-local dedupe and opt-in stale refresh. Authorization stays outside.
when_to_use: Read-only R2, D1, Durable Object, Analytics Engine or API projections tolerate an explicit freshness window.
Many callers reuse the same tenant-scoped result.
when_not_to_use: Authentication, permissions, revocation, balances or state requiring immediate consistency.
Large binary assets, streaming results, or hot mutable KV keys.

adapt.title: Provision the optional KV tier
adapt.do: Replace the KV placeholder ID with an existing namespace, or omit kv in the utility options and remove the optional binding.
adapt.check: With KV omitted the same loader works through the edge tier.

adapt.title: Authorize, scope, and version the result
adapt.do: After authorization, create one cache per request. Supply trusted scope/tenant/version keys, a runtime parser and a bounded JSON loader for the chosen source. Scope source queries to the tenant; include all query inputs in keys. Bypass forces a loader call subject to source consistency.
adapt.check: Different tenants/versions never share results; bypass executes the store loader.

agent.author_notes: Fresh-only default. KV is eventually consistent and cache deletion is not global invalidation. Version changes must come from authoritative state; a KV-cached revision pointer does not guarantee immediate freshness. Dedupe is only within one request.
